music.name: music-marais
music.prompt: Calm eerie marsh exploration theme, quiet and sparse: a detuned music box plays a slow fragile melody over a low bowed double-bass drone, a distant bell tolls now and then, soft harp arpeggios fall like dripping water, and a far breathy flute drifts in and out. Dark, melancholic, foggy still water at night, uneasy but gentle, steady throughout with no climax. 80 BPM.

music.name: music-dame
music.prompt: Ominous boss theme, a ruined wedding waltz in 3/4: a detuned music box carries a broken bridal melody over a heavy low cello and contrabass ostinato, deep timpani hits mark the downbeats, a distant wordless female choir hums behind, and church bell tolls ring through. Tragic, oppressive and dreadful, building steadily in weight and intensity from a bare opening to a crushing full ensemble. 96 BPM.

music.name: music-marsh-arrival-a
music.prompt: Very slow cinematic cue for arriving at a drowned marsh, about 56 BPM: a low sustained drone holds underneath, a lone woman hums a wordless lullaby far away, isolated celesta notes ring out one at a time with long silences, and water drips in the dark. Still, cold, mournful and uneasy, ending on the drone left alone. 60 BPM.
